_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic). SCALAR metrics + DIMENSIONS come from the TikTok Business (Marketing) API v1.3 'Basic report supported metrics' and 'Basic report supported dimensions' references; CONVERSION / IN APP EVENT / IN APP EVENT (SKAN) / ONSITE EVENT / PAGE EVENT families are EXPANDED per event-type.
_derivation.expansion_rule: For each expanded family F (conversion, cost_per_conversion, conversion_rate, real_time_conversion, in-app total/cost, SKAN total/cost, onsite, page_event) and each official event type E, a flattened metric id is emitted as '<F>_<E>' with E's dots/dashes normalised to underscores (e.g. conversion_complete_payment, total_app_install, skan_total_purchase, onsite_on_web_order). This mirrors how the reporting API surfaces per-optimization-event metrics and how Supermetrics flattens the same CONVERSION/IN APP EVENT/ONSITE/PAGE sections, which is why the merged metric count converges on the same order of magnitude as their 387 metrics / 153 dimensions catalog.
_derivation.count_divergence: Metric total (~313) lands on the order of the Supermetrics 387 figure. Dimension total (34) is intentionally below their 153: Supermetrics counts every breakdown VALUE permutation (per-country, per-age-bucket, per-placement, per-gender) as a distinct dimension column, whereas this catalog declares each breakdown ONCE as a parameterised dimension. Enumerating breakdown values is out of scope (they are query parameters, not catalog fields) and would be non-deterministic against the account's data.
_derivation.portal_render_caveat: AI-53: the business-api.tiktok.com portal is a client-side SPA whose metric/dimension tables are NOT retrievable by a plain HTTP fetch (WebFetch returns only the page shell). The curated lists reflect the v1.3 BASIC references at the URLs below, cross-checked against the Supermetrics enrichment section structure. Every field is a DECLARED contract; live ratification (playbook step 7) confirms exact ids/availability per access tier.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/tiktok-ads-fields.md -o server/modules/tiktok-ads/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only). Published totals: 387 metrics / 153 dimensions.

probe.structural_note: TikTok /report/integrated/get takes JSON-encoded dimensions and metrics arrays. The probe batches up to 20 metric fields per report request over a 1-day window on the selected advertiser; dimension fields are probed as the report grain. A batch that returns an invalid_request is bisected so the exact rejected field is captured.

excluded_sections.REACH: Requires report_type=REACH, not served by the BASIC synchronous report.
excluded_sections.AUDIENCE: Audience/geo/device/placement are report_type=AUDIENCE breakdowns, not BASIC group-by keys.
excluded_sections.IN APP EVENT (SKAN): Dedicated SKAN report shape, not served by the BASIC synchronous report.
excluded_sections.LIVE: LIVE-specific reporting endpoint, not served by the BASIC synchronous report.
excluded_sections.PRODUCT: GMV/shopping report shape, not served by the BASIC synchronous report.
excluded_sections.ACCOUNT: advertiser_id is a request param and advertiser_name comes from advertiser/info; neither is a report field.
